info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Violations-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservation Violations API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of violations related to parking reservations. This endpoint provides essential information about non-compliance incidents, empowering enforcement agencies or property managers to monitor and address issues efficiently. Common users of this API include city officials, parking authorities, and businesses managing parking facilities. By leveraging the data from this API, stakeholders can enhance compliance strategies and improve overall service quality in parking management.

get.description: Fetches a list of violations associated with reservations. This endpoint allows users to understand any issues or breaches linked to their reservations, enabling better management and compliance.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching violation details related to reservations. This request includes parameters essential for retrieving specific violation information as per the business logic.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the violation data is returned.
